editions.credit: Homilies on the Second Epistle to the Corinthians, in A Select Library of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series I, vol. XII (Homilies on the Epistles of Paul to the Corinthians), trans. The Oxford translation (Library of the Fathers), revised for the American edition; the original Oxford translators are not named on the pages opened; revised with additional notes by Talbot W. Chambers (Buffalo; New York: Christian Literature Co., 1889). Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0).
